merchandisingData.promotionDescription: Get a 50% Profit Boost to use on a 3+ leg NBA SGP or SGPx bet today!
merchandisingData.terms:
1. Opt-in and get One (1) Profit Boost for all NBA games on 10/28/2026!
2. Profit Boost: 50% (Profit boost only applies to winnings, excluding original bet amount)
3. Profit Boost Token only applies to a NBA SGP or SGPx bet. All other bet types are excluded from this promotion.
    1. Parlays req. min. 3 legs.
    2. Total bet odds must be +300 or longer.
    3. Max betting limits apply.
4. Profit Boost Token expires at the end of the final NBA game on 10/28/2026
5. You must select the Profit Boost Token in your betslip BEFORE placing the Qualifying Bet to apply the promotion.
6. Wagering on this promotion must use funds from your cash balance or DK Dollars. Bets placed with other bonus rewards are void. Cashed out bets and voided bets will void this promotion.
7. Eligibility: Must be 21+ and physically located in AR, AZ, CO, CT, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, VA, VT, WA, or WV. 18+ and physically located in CA-AB/DC/NH/PR (residents only)/WY. 19+ and physically located in CA-ONT.

Customers found to be abusing this Promotion may be removed from this Promotion and/or all future Promotions.

Thank you for choosing to participate in this promotion (the "Promotion") being offered by DraftKings. By entering or participating in the Promotion you hereby agree to be bound by these Promotion terms (the "Promotion Terms," together with the DraftKings Terms of Use and General Rules, the "Terms"). If you do not wish to be bound by the Promotion Terms, please do not enter or participate in the Promotion. If you have any questions regarding the Promotion or the Terms, or wish to cancel your participation in this Promotion, please contact support@draftkings.com for more information.

(1) DESCRIPTION

Get a 50% Profit Boost on a NBA SGP or SGPx bet!

(2) DATE AND TIME OF PROMOTION

The promotional offer is valid between 10/28/2026 at 03:00 AM Eastern Time (ET) and the end of the final NBA game on 10/28/2026 (the "Promotional Period").

(3) ELIGIBILITY

To be eligible for DraftKings Sportsbook and the Promotion, you must be physically located in CA-AB, CA-ONT, AR, AZ, CO, CT, DC, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, PR (residents only), TN, VA, VT, WA, WV, or WY (each an "Eligible Jurisdiction" or, collectively, the "Eligible Jurisdictions"). Must be 21+ years of age or older (18+ if in CA-AB/DC/NH/PR (residents only)/WY) (19+ if in CA-ONT). Any customer who is found to be ineligible to play on DraftKings (i.e., by way of self-exclusion from gambling, restriction due to employment, or otherwise) may not participate in this Promotion and immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded under this Promotion.

Customers must be invited to receive this Promotion. Promotion is only valid for the intended recipient - customers who receive this offer via an email forward, screenshot, or other means shall not be eligible.

(4) REQUIRED ACTIONS

In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the Terms, to participate in the Promotion, customers must (1) be a registered DraftKings Sportsbook customer with an active account; (2) receive an offer to participate in this Promotion; and (3) if required, opt-in by clicking the appropriate link/button within the Promotional Period.

(5) BONUS REWARD REDEMPTION AND LIMITATIONS

Upon completion of the promotion requirements, eligible customers will be awarded One (1) 50% Profit Boost Token (the "Token"). Token will boost Qualifying Bet profit 50%. Token valid only for a NBA SGP or SGPx bet (the "Qualifying Bet"). See Section 8 Wagering Restrictions and Limitations for Qualifying Wager details.

PROFIT BOOST LIMITATIONS

Profit Boost Tokens are single-use and have no cash value. Token must be applied BEFORE placing bet. Profit boost is calculated on and only applies to net winnings (total payout less Qualifying Bet amount). Subject to any maximum bet limitations, there are no restrictions on the funds a customer will receive if their bet wins. Profit Boosts may not be combined with other bonus rewards and may not be eligible for use on all promotions and/or betting markets. Token expires at the end of the final NBA game on 10/28/2026.

When customers successfully enter and complete the Promotion requirements, they will receive notice by app push, in-app bell notification, app pop, or email.

(6) REGISTRATION

See DraftKings Terms of Use for information on eligibility for creating, using, and funding an interactive gaming account.

(7) LIMITS ON PARTICIPATION

Limit One (1) redemption per customer. Reward substitutions or changes will be made in DraftKings's sole discretion. See DraftKings Sportsbook Terms of Use for information and limitations on wagering.

(8) WAGERING RESTRICTIONS AND LIMITATIONS

Qualifying Bet must be placed using cash from your cash balance or DK Dollars. Qualifying Bet must have minimum odds of +300 or longer (+310, +350, +400, etc.). Maximum bet limits will be clearly and conspicuously disclosed to the customer upon opting in. Parlays require minimum 3 legs. Only eligible legs of the Qualifying Bet will receive a profit boost; any ineligible legs (including legs from non-eligible leagues, games, or sports) will not receive a boost.

All other bet types are excluded from this Promotion. Cashed-out bets and voided bets will void this Promotion. Bets placed with bonus rewards (including but not limited to Bonus Bets, Odds Boosts/Surges, Profit Boosts, etc.) are not valid.

(9) ORDER OF FUNDS USED FOR WAGERING

Funds are wagered in the following order: (i) DK Dollars, then (ii) Cash in your cash balance.

(10) ELIGIBLE GAMES

Promotion Eligible Games: Token valid only for a NBA SGP or SGPx bet.

(11) RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL OF FUNDS

You may withdraw funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the Promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. Subject to any play-through restrictions in connection with a promotion, funds earned from winnings may be withdrawn at any time.

(12) RULES REGARDING CANCELLATION

Should you wish to cancel your participation in this promotion at any time, please contact customer experience at sportsbook@draftkings.com. Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any remaining funds deposited in connection with this promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. However, any applicable bonus rewards in your account shall be void, subject to forfeiture, and may not be transferred or withdrawn.

(13) RESPONSIBLE GAMING

If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, help is available, Call 1-800-GAMBLER, or 1-800-MY-RESET. In Ontario: Concerned about your Gambling? Call ConnexOntario 1-866-531-2600. In Alberta: If gambling is affecting your mental health or well-being, 211 Alberta is here to help. Call or text 211 or visit ab.211.ca.

(14) OTHER INFORMATION

Whether a customer has committed abuse of this Promotion, or violated the Terms, will be determined by DraftKings in its sole discretion, for any reason or no reason at all. All promotions are subject to the DraftKings Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. By accepting any bonus rewards, registered customers agree to abide by the Terms. Promotional offer is subject to regulatory approval. Void where prohibited by law. DraftKings account holders are responsible for any and all local, state, or federal taxes. DraftKings is not liable for computer or program malfunctions, nor for errors in bonus rewards. DraftKings reserves the right to exclude or remove certain customers from this Promotion, as well as the right to withhold bonus rewards if you have violated or attempted to violate the Terms, including but not limited to sharing account credentials with other individuals, placing wagers on behalf of other individuals, circumventing DraftKings age and location verification procedures, and abusing the DraftKings Platform, the Services, or any bonuses, the refer-a-friend program, or any other offers or promotions, including this Promotion, in any way.

If physically located in PA, this Promotion will comply with subsection §813.3 regarding cancellation in this Promotion by a customer.

If in NY, if a customer is dissatisfied with any resolution between the customer and DraftKings, the customer may then submit an inquiry with the New York State Gaming Commission.

See DraftKings Terms of Use for information on eligibility for creating, using, and funding an interactive gaming account. DraftKings reserves the right to suspend, modify, and/or cancel this Promotion for any reason in its sole discretion.
